assign.outcome:
**All seven minors fixed, smallest change each, re-shot after every one.**

1. **Make - the drawer's twelve nest chips** wear `.picked` now (a light fill, `--prim` border, a tick) instead of `.on` - the same class `.paging-act` uses for real buttons ("Put it inside" 280px below). `config.js`, `paging.css`. [png](01-after-1280.png)
2. **The two colour swatches** carry a `title` ("content colour: Card") and card / tint each get their own edge - card the surface's own soft shadow, tint a dashed hairline - so the three near-white answers no longer look like one empty box. `toolbar.js`, `paging.css`. [png](02-after-1280.png)
3. **Importance judge cards** wear a QUESTION / CAVEAT tag beside a now-titled glyph - the same one-word tag the ranked view already uses for TOPIC. `views.js`. [png](03-after-1280.png)
4. **`qualifies`** reads "qualifies the answer above" instead of a bare verb. `views.js`. [png](04-after-1280.png)
5. **The `/imagine/` wall** - the false "Nothing here opens a new screen" line is gone, and every one of the 24 descriptions now ends at its own real sentence (no clamp at all beat a 4-line clamp, which still cut 9 of 24 mid-word; the grid's `stretch` keeps each ROW even). `page.js`, `imagine.css`. [png](05-after-1280.png)
6. **The reason box** carries a `title` naming its own key rule, the same as the name box beside it. `views.js`. [png](06-after-1280.png)
7. **The unarmed Reset** reads "Reset the pages you made" - `this.what`, which `confirm()` already used, now carries the first press too. `baseline.js`. [png](07-after-1280.png)

**Cleanup.** No probe pages made or needed - every fix was a label, a class or a CSS rule, provable by `eval` and a screenshot. `diff -r` of `made/` against the pre-gesture scratchpad copy is empty and `git status public/imagine/paging/made/` matches the five lines it already carried (3 modified, 2 untracked). The three importance data files hash identically before and after: nodes `20ab6e35`, edges `cc5bb7bd`, judgments `9234ba29` (4/3/3 rows). One real catch: verifying finding 1 on the cold-loaded (owner's) picked page wrote `nest: "blog-post"` straight to `made/notes/page.json` - `nest_to()` on a made page writes through with no Save button. Caught by `diff -r` against the scratchpad baseline (git diff against HEAD hid it in older unrelated noise), restored from that copy, logged to `ui-test/improvements.md`. Zero console errors across both headless runs. Private server on 8093, killed by pid (29500); port 80 never touched.
